name: Groundwork Core
purpose: The base every project gets, whatever it is: project definition, agent instructions, product and system requirements with traceable IDs, the architecture starting point, decisions, plans and the shared checks. Always active; profiles add to it and never change it.

documents.when: The project handles user data, accounts, payments, secrets or anything worth attacking. Shipped in place; delete it only if none of that applies.
The project has code that needs more than one kind of test. Shipped in place.
You are choosing how to lay out the repository. Shipped in place; delete it once the layout is settled.
The system has several actors, external systems or boundaries worth describing beyond the summary in SYSTEM_DESIGN.md.
The system keeps its own data or state with rules about who owns it.
State changes follow rules that must always hold (invariants, transitions, validation).
The system has more than one component, or integrates with outside services.
Things run concurrently, in the background, or can fail part-way and need recovery.
The team deploys, monitors or scales running services itself.
User actions in an interface trigger system operations that change state.
The product has a visual or interactive interface.
An interface has several consumers, outside teams or versioning needs, so it needs a written contract.
